metadata.title: GLM-5.3 Credits & Subscription Pricing
metadata.description: Flexible permanent credit packs and developer subscriptions for GLM-5.3 (753B) and GLM-5.3-Flash.

messages.title: Choose your creative pace
messages.monthly_description: Choose your monthly creative allowance. Renews monthly; stop future renewal anytime.
messages.annual_description: Pay once for the year. Receive credits each service month and cancel next year's renewal anytime.
messages.credits_description: Buy credits as needed. They never expire, require no subscription and do not renew.
messages.annual_credit_validity: Monthly credits expire at service month end; no rollover
messages.credit_period_validity: Credits expire at period end; no rollover
messages.monthly_note: Credit usage varies by model, duration and resolution. Confirmed payments grant the current allowance, valid until the billing period ends, with no rollover. Permanent credits are unchanged.
messages.annual_note: Charged yearly, with credits released each service month—not all at once. Unused monthly credits expire without rollover; inactive months do not accumulate. Canceling renewal preserves the remaining paid year's monthly allowances.
messages.credits_note: One-time payment. Credits never expire and do not renew. Expiring subscription credits are used before permanent credits. Credit use depends on the model, resolution and duration.
messages.checkout_error: Unable to open checkout. Please try again.
messages.checkout_retry: Checkout could not be confirmed. Retry the same plan to safely resume the original order.
messages.checkout_in_progress: You already have an unfinished checkout. Resume it, or return after it expires (within 24 hours) to choose another plan.
messages.checkout_expired_retry: Your previous checkout has expired. Choose a plan again to start a new checkout.
messages.checkout_needs_review: An earlier checkout needs reconciliation. Contact support with your order details before opening another payment.
messages.plan_not_configured: This plan is not available yet. Please try again later.
messages.payment_unavailable: Checkout is not available yet. Please try again later.
messages.pricing_changed: Prices or credits have changed. Refresh the prices, review the updated plans, then choose again. No new checkout was created.
messages.pricing_refresh_error: Unable to refresh prices. Your previous quote is no longer valid. Refresh again before purchasing.
messages.pricing_updated: Prices and credits updated. Review the plans and choose again to continue.
messages.price_currency: All purchases are charged in US dollars (USD)
